consequence.statement: Environments setting the frontend.cache-split-interval CLI flag will have that configuration ignored; results caching interval must be controlled via querier.split-queries-by-interval instead.
consequence.remediation: Replace the frontend.cache-split-interval CLI flag with querier.split-queries-by-interval in your Loki configuration or deployment.

assertion.statement: The frontend.cache-split-interval CLI flag is removed; results caching interval is now determined by querier.split-queries-by-interval.
